verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation, such as install hooks or lifecycle scripts, is a fair axis for a package manager, but the evidence documents no user-definable rules that fire actions on events. The closest items are built-in automatic behaviors (frozen-lockfile mode in CI, version switching from packageManager) and patches reapplied on install. These are adjacent features, not user-defined event rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
